newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Electro Power reports $1.8 mln yr net profit.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Electro Power reports $1.8 mln yr net profit.

text.p: Palmerston North power company Electro Power on Monday reported an annual net profit of NZ$1.8 million, representing a 12 percent return on shareholders' funds.
Excluding non-recurring abnormals, the net profit was $2.0 million. The company gave no comparative figures and executives were not available for comment.

The company, owned by Palmerston North City Council, said highlights included a decision to cut fixed charges by 10 percent in April. It also offered customers, on a trial basis, access to their account details on the Internet.
